title: Gate restriction for a circuit family
statement: Let $S$ be a set of gate operations on the binary alphabet. A layered circuit family uses only gates from $S$ if, for every input length, its circuit uses only gate operations belonging to $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a set of gate operations on the binary alphabet
The condition is required for every natural number input length
caveat: The snippet does not define the predicate that a particular layered circuit uses only specified gates.
